'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Drew Scott DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Drew Scott]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' You're the Best!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
